adjudication.rationale: In db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb the migration does `execute(...)[0]['id'].to_i` to derive `category_id` from the `embed_category` site setting. If the SELECT returns no rows (e.g., setting unset, deleted, or value doesn’t match any `categories.name`), `[0]` is `nil` and `['id']` will raise NoMethodError/IndexError before the `if category_id == 0` fallback can run. This is a real crash path shown directly in the diff.
